verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Financial Connections collects and verifies bank accounts for ACH Direct Debit payments built on the connection, and lets users save and reuse those bank details. It also claims to reduce failures from closed or inactive accounts, which implies repeated debits. However, no evidence explicitly documents recurring or subscription debits, mandates, or standing consents. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented recurring ACH debit or mandate flow, any variable recurring payment or standing consent support, and hands-on or independent corroboration of recurring billing on connected accounts.
